summary: The individual expresses opposition to maintaining local control over screen-time expectations and urges the FCC to reject proposals that would narrow or sunset the E-Rate program. The individual emphasizes the role of the E-Rate program in providing access to the internet and education during their youth.

claims.requested_action: Maintain local control over screen-time expectations
claims.argument: Screen-time expectations should remain a local issue
claims.evidence_quote: It is because of the E-Rate program that the schools I attended, and the few public libraries I visited during my youth, were able to provide me with the ability to access the internet and gave me the potential to learn as much as I could. Therefore, I believe screen-time expectations should remain strictly a local issue
